title: Sv39 in one picture
subtitle: A 39-bit virtual address, three 9-bit table indices and a page offset

cells.name: VPN[2]
cells.detail: Indexes the root (L2) table, one of 512 eight-byte entries

cells.name: VPN[1]
cells.detail: Indexes the L1 table the L2 entry points to

cells.name: VPN[0]
cells.detail: Indexes the L0 table, whose entry is the leaf for a 4 KiB page

cells.name: page offset
cells.detail: Byte within the 4 KiB page, copied straight into the physical address

rows.label: the walk

chain.name: L2 table
chain.detail: One 4 KiB page of 512 PTEs, found through satp

chain.name: L1 table
chain.detail: Reached when the L2 entry has only V set

chain.name: L0 table
chain.detail: Reached when the L1 entry has only V set

chain.name: leaf PTE
chain.detail: Any of R, W or X set makes an entry a leaf

rows.note: An entry with only V set points to the next table; any of R, W or X makes it a leaf.

cells.name: PPN
cells.detail: Physical page number of the mapped page

cells.name: D
cells.detail: Dirty. Without Svadu, hardware faults on a write to a page with D clear instead of setting it

cells.name: A
cells.detail: Accessed. Without Svadu, hardware faults on an access with A clear instead of setting it

cells.name: G
cells.detail: Global mapping, present in every address space
